sharedPolicy.teamScope: The team currently controlling the source restricts only the opposing team's new Trap Card activations.
sharedPolicy.controllerResolution: Use the team Monster Zone containing the source, not the physical owner encoded by its m0–m3 UID; this preserves stolen-card control.
sharedPolicy.phaseResolution: Battle Phase remains active during response/choice windows whose resume phase is battle; Main Phase response/choice windows do not inherit the restriction.
exclusions: the source while its monster effect is negated
Quick-Play Spells and all non-Trap activations
Trap effects that were already activated before the Battle Phase
sharedPolicy.negation: The adapter requires the caller to inject the selected engine revision's monster-effect-negation resolver; it never guesses or caches negation.

coverage: both official card identities map to the same ContinuousRule accepted by continuousRuleIssues
